sentence: a jump goes 2x / 8.4x higher; a cup falls 1.4x / 2.9x slower; 70 kg weighs 8.3 kg at 1.5 h
claim: With the same push, jump height grows as gravity shrinks: about 2 times higher at a 2 h day and 8.4 times at 1.5 h; a falling cup takes 1.4 and 2.9 times longer.
note: DERIVATION: arithmetic only; OPEN until a person re-does the sum.
derivation: With the same push, jump height is proportional to 1/g_eff and fall time to 1/sqrt(g_eff), where g_eff = weight fraction x g (c5): at 2 h (50.4%) the height is 1.98x and the fall time 1.41x; at 1.5 h (11.9%) 8.4x and 2.9x; 70 kg x 0.119 = 8.3 kg.
